entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hm, it seems police have[n]shown up at our school.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Your sister hasn't told[n]you about any of this?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Could this be related to[n]Okumura's death in some way?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But there's no connection between[n]our school and Okumura Foods.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Think they came to talk to Haru?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I can't even begin to[n]fathom the reason.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Anyhow, let's be particularly[n]careful not to stand out.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: And head straight home[n]once school ends.
